sources.title: Laws of Montserrat, Labour Code Cap. 15.03 (revision date 1 January 2025), ss. 126-129, and Labour Code (Work Permits Fees) Regulations (S.R.O.s 5/1984, 5/1993, 23/2004 and 36/2012)
sources.said: a person who is not a Montserratian shall not engage in employment or self-employment in Montserrat unless he or she has a work permit. … A work permit shall be issued by the Governor, acting on the advice of the Cabinet. (b) A renewal, extension or temporary work permit shall be issued by the Minister. (2) An application for a work permit shall be made by the intended employer on behalf of the person for whom the permit is sought, by filing an application, in the prescribed form, with the Labour Commissioner. … (o) writers, journalists, broadcasters, photographers, sculptors and painters (excluding commercial and industrial photographers and painters); … (b) proof of advertisement of the post in Montserrat; (c) the reason for employing a non-national; (d) a statement of the proposed terms of employment, including the basic rate of pay, … Entertainer (under one week) … 300 (over one week) … .. 500 … Application filed on island (stamp) … 20 … The fee for the issue of a work permit to a Non- Caricom National shall be the fee for the issue of work permit to a Caricom National plus an additional $300. … (a) Caricom Nationals $ 75 (b) Non-Caricom Nationals $125
